note: One 128-bit tag per protocol message per recipient; block dissemination counted as one message per recipient per block (fragmenting multiplies it). Decision rate = the rate at which the counted message pattern repeats. Sources are the specification or paper read in paper-sources/deep/batch_*.md and the live queries in *_live.json (2026-10-11/12).

chains.protocol: Jolteon with broadcast votes and order votes
chains.pattern_src: aptos2024aip89: proposal to all, every validator broadcasts a vote and an order vote
chains.rate_src: block timestamps of the second Aptos sample (QKD_FEASIBILITY.json)

chains.pattern_src: buchman2018tendermint: proposer broadcasts PROPOSAL; every process broadcasts PREVOTE and PRECOMMIT (direct broadcast is the lower bound; gossip adds hops)
chains.rate_src: cosmos campaign: one block per 5.9 s

chains.pattern_src: grandpa2020: primary broadcasts an estimate, every voter broadcasts a prevote and a precommit (commit messages not counted)
chains.rate_src: no round rate in the paper; blocks every 6.0 s (polkadot_live.json) are not rounds

chains.protocol: Mysticeti: one block per validator per round
chains.pattern_src: mysticeti2023: each validator multicasts one signed block per round to all others; votes and certificates implicit
chains.rate_src: no round rate in the paper

chains.protocol: Tower BFT: votes to the slot leader, block by Turbine tree
chains.pattern_src: solana2026docs: validators transmit votes to the leader; the leader's block reaches every validator over the Turbine tree, counted as one message per validator
chains.rate_src: solana_live.json: 2001 blocks in 441 s, 0.2205 s per slot

chains.protocol: Snowball: k random queries per round, beta rounds
chains.pattern_src: avalanche2019snow: each node queries k random peers per round and collects replies until beta consecutive successes; defaults K=20, Beta=20 from avalanchego parameters.go
chains.rate_src: avalanche_live.json: C-chain 20000 blocks at 0.9943 s per block
chains.persistence_note: a fresh uniform sample each round: about K/(n-1) of pairs recur

chains.protocol: Beacon chain: one attestation per validator per epoch, aggregated
chains.pattern_src: eth2026specs: N attestations per epoch plus 64 committees per slot x 16 aggregators x 32 slots = 32768 aggregates to the proposers (spec constants MAX_COMMITTEES_PER_SLOT, TARGET_AGGREGATORS_PER_COMMITTEE, SLOTS_PER_EPOCH); the minimum with direct delivery, before gossip fan-out
chains.rate_src: one epoch of 32 slots of 12 s = 384 s (SLOT_DURATION_MS 12000)
